title: Email assistant review
review_question: What could happen if a malicious message influences subsequent drafts, and which facts determine whether that influence can propagate?
retrieval_focus: Retrieved email examples steering drafted replies, malicious attachments and instruction-like content in incoming mail
system_description: An assistant retrieves earlier messages as examples, then drafts a reply to the incoming email. Users review the draft before it is used.
users_and_roles: People who can send email to the mailbox owner
untrusted_inputs: Incoming email from outside the organization
tools_and_permissions: Draft a reply in the mailbox
existing_controls: The user reads the draft before sending
constraints: The boundary between drafting and sending is a deployment choice
No calendar or file access in the reviewed configuration
unknowns: Whether any deployment sends drafts automatically
Whether retrieved examples are filtered by sender trust
